initialIOS26Attempt.result: Tool said TEST SUCCEEDED and exited 0 but executed no tests; not a pass.
initialIOS26Attempt.followUp: Both suite and exact-selection enumeration found the methods enabled. One unchanged fresh attempt then executed all four. The cause of the empty attempt is unproved.

assessment: The original seven disabled-control observations are specifically outside the WCAG 1.4.3 minimum text-contrast requirement; broader accessibility remains unaccepted.
The original Add caretaker crop is fully visible and measures 13.56:1; the prior blanket scroll-boundary explanation was incorrect for that label.
Original Text messages and Waiting for them to join diagnostic crops contain navigation chrome covering their lettering. Both fully exposed screens pass on both runtimes.
All four target geometry/enabled-state assertions pass. Their measured opaque text/background pairs range from 8.33:1 to 14.69:1 on both runtimes.
iOS 27 retains two contrast reports: disabled Share contacts once and the introductory paragraph extending above navigation. Neither report identifies a fully exposed target.

iOS 26.5 retains three contrast reports: the same partially covered paragraph and two Your contacts reports with no associated element or element crop. Those two cannot be assigned to a specific control and remain unresolved.
The paragraph diagnostic includes uncovered high-contrast ending lines and covered earlier lines; it is partially, not completely, obscured.
No automated-framework cause is established. Passing target measurements are not a passing whole-screen audit or real-device accessibility acceptance.

assessment: Both explicit-sharing and name-versus-action interaction methods pass on both runtimes.
The four contrast methods still pass two and fail two on each runtime; all target geometry assertions pass.

Integrated iOS 27 has one unassociated Your contacts contrast report and the partially covered introductory paragraph. The unassociated report cannot be assigned to the disabled Share contacts button.
Integrated iOS 26.5 has two unassociated Your contacts contrast reports and the same partially covered paragraph.
Current opaque target text/background ratios remain 8.33:1 through 14.69:1. This is not a blanket audit pass, a framework-cause attribution or physical accessibility acceptance.
The unsigned release archive passes package/privacy/fixture inspection. It is not distribution-signed, physically installed or submitted to Apple.
